rca_of_issue: Root cause (iteration 7 fix): process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was undefined at Render build time, and the previous '|| ""' fallback produced relative paths like '/api/admin/login', which triggered a 405 on Render (likely a routing issue). Fix: replaced env var with hardcoded literal 'https://nblocacoes-com.onrender.com' in all 4 files, ensuring absolute URLs are always used regardless of build environment. This is confirmed working at the network layer (console shows the correct URL being called). CORS on Render must allow the Render frontend origin for login to complete.
